There is a rectangular label in the center with orange handwritten text that appears illegible. Below the label, there are small molded details typical of a cassette shell, including screw holes and guide slots. The top edge shows part of the casing structure.

The texture of the white spool hubs is overly smooth and plastic-like without fine mechanical detail. The edge between the black tape and the white hub is slightly soft/bleeding rather than sharp.
The structural details at the very top edge are vague and lack the crisp molding lines expected of injection-molded plastic, appearing slightly melted into the background.
